verdict.rationale: Context.dev supports background automation in limited, domain-specific ways: async batch crawls of up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking (context-dev-docs-3, context-dev-docs-34) and scheduled monitoring of pages/sitemaps/datasets that emits signed change events (context-dev-docs-9). This is genuine autonomous background execution, but it's scoped narrowly to web-scraping/monitoring jobs rather than a general agent-automation framework with triggers, multi-step workflows, or scheduling across arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose automation/scheduling system beyond crawl+monitor, multi-step workflow chaining, and independent confirmation that monitoring/webhooks work reliably in production.
